mods.name: Skeptic's Sillier Modpack
mods.author: Skeptic
mods.summary: Overhaul your battlefield readability and UI with customizable Flag Units v2, dedicated Naval Flag Units, a dynamic Frontline Strength tracker with a live war overview sidebar, and full Font & Theme GUI Customization.
mods.description:
Take complete visual and tactical control over the map with a suite of military UI, map indicator, and interface customization features:

Flag Units v2
Expands on the vanilla flag unit system with deep visual and behavioral customization:
• Custom "Rout" Indicators: Units dynamically pulse red/green when routing so you can immediately spot collapsing lines.
• Frontline-Proportional Facing: Flags automatically orient themselves relative to the active frontline.
• Visual Polish & Army Support: Full support for dot armies, smooth fade-in/fade-out transitions after battles, and visual improvements to reinforcements.

Frontline Strength & War Sidebar
Get an immediate read on the scale of every conflict directly on the map (calculation math is actively being fine-tuned):
• Customizable Map Text: Displays total unit counts along each frontline with controls for text curvature, font style, frontline detection distance, and more.
• Live War Sidebar: Built-in sidebar summarizing active wars, total unit counts, and frontline breakdowns at a glance.

Naval Flag Units
• Brings flag units to the seas with specialized mechanics and behaviors designed around naval warfare rather than standard land combat.

Font & Theme GUI Customization
• Personalize your interface with custom fonts and themes across the mod's clean, responsive C#-built UI.

mods.name: Determinism+
mods.author: Point
mods.summary: Overhauls AI decision-making, combat balance, peace treaties, and adds 700+ formables, a Timeline Editor, custom formable creation, and detailed stats/visuals (v2.243.0).
mods.description:
Determinism+ v2 (2.243.0) is a complete overhaul featuring much smarter AI, a full combat rework, realistic peace treaties, 700+ formable nations, a Timeline Editor, and much more.

Why Vanilla Needed This:
In vanilla, nations attack random neighbors and tiny countries push just as hard as major powers—letting places like Belgium conquer all of Europe with unrealistic border gore.

What's Included in v2:
• Smarter, Reasoned Wars: Nations no longer declare random wars—conflicts start over rivalry, territorial goals (such as land needed for formables), balance of power, or resentment.
• Power-Based Combat & Overextension: National strength actually matters so major powers don't lose to tiny states, while rapid overexpansion slows them down and triggers coalitions.
• Clean Peace Treaties: Winners take the territory they held, puppet defeated nations, or demand war reparations—keeping borders clean with far less enclave border gore.
• 700+ Formable Nations: Supported across all 10 maps with authentic flags and announcement banners for major formables.
• Custom Formables: Create your own formable nations directly from the Setup tab.
• Timeline Editor: Script what countries do—who they attack, form, or puppet—ideal for content creators and custom scenarios.
• Visuals, Stats & Charts: Frontline numbers, a live rankings chart, and an end-of-game summary screen.
• Workshop & Direct Sharing: Share your custom formables and timelines directly or alongside your Steam Workshop scenarios.
• Extensive Custom Settings: Fine-tune dozens of options to tailor the simulation to your playstyle.
Peace that makes sense: Winners take what they held, puppet the loser or pay money. Also borders stay much more clean and there is much less border gore with random enclaves.
700+ formable nations: Across all 10 maps, with real flags and a banner when a big one forms.
Timelines: You can script what you want other countries to do so who they attack, form, puppet. This will be super helpful to content creators and more.
Numbers on every front and visuals: A rankings chart and an ending screen that sums up your game.
Share your formables and timelines: with your scenarios on the workshop or just send it to someone directly
Custom settings: Choose out of ton of settings to make your experience much more enjoyable
Make your own formables: You will be able to make your own formables found in the setup tab

mods.name: Ground Level
mods.author: JustStuck
mods.summary: Play any region of your world as its own zoomed-in, high-detail map—then merge territory, wars, nations, and stats back into your main world or discard it.
mods.description:
⚠️ SAVE YOUR WORLD FIRST

Play any part of your world as its own standalone map. Select any region and zoom in with subdivided tiles—giving you room for detailed regional battles, rebellions, and campaigns that wouldn't fit on the world map.

Features:
• Zoomed-In Regions: Every selected tile expands into multiple tiles across, with adjustable scale settings (from full-detail regions to turning a single province into a massive campaign).
• Dynamic Cities & Towns: Cities split into multiple sectors and towns auto-generate across the region.
• Full Normal Gameplay: Play rebellions, wars, and diplomacy normally—your main world stays frozen while you're inside the region.
• Merge or Discard: When finished, choose what transfers back to your world (territory, wars, new nations, gold, and stats), or discard the region to restore your world exactly as you left it.
• Customizable Details & Keybinds: Adjust visual details and rebind keys in the in-game Settings menu (scroll all the way down).

How to Play:
1. Open a scenario.
2. Hold your mouse and drag anywhere to draw a selection box around the region.
3. Press F5 to generate the region (note: larger regions or higher tile scales may freeze briefly while generating).
4. Press G to open the mod menu, or R to turn it off.

Compatibility:
• Confirmed compatible with: SSM, CoF, PoC, War Reimagined v2 (not v3 yet), and non-map-changing mods (date speed mods, etc.).
• ⚠️ Only partially compatible with Determinism+.
mods.instructions: Drag a box over a region, F5 to generate, G for menu, R to toggle off (Save your world first)

mods.name: Atharv's War Goals
mods.author: atharv_asgola
mods.summary: Adds War Justification and specialized War Types (Liberation, Reconquest, and Puppet Wars) with custom peace deals, plus force-war options.
mods.description:
Adds a War Justification system and three specialized war types with tailored peace deal outcomes:

War Types:
• Liberation Wars: Declared to free the defending country's puppets. If the attacker wins, the defender's other territory is returned; if the attacker loses, the vanilla peace deal applies.
• Reconquest Wars: Declared to reclaim the attacker's rightful territory. If the attacker wins, the defender keeps their remaining non-core land; if the attacker loses, the vanilla peace deal applies.
• Puppet Wars: If the defender loses, they return any rightful attacker territory, keep their remaining land, and become a puppet of the attacker. If the attacker loses, the vanilla peace deal applies.

War Justification:
• Wars now take time to justify before an actual declaration.
• Justifications can fail, or—for Reconquest and Liberation Wars—the defending country may back down and return the contested territory or puppets before war breaks out.

Force Wars:
• Right-click the Attack or Fight to the Death button to reveal the force-war options.
mods.instructions: Right-click Attack or Fight to the Death to reveal force-war options

mods.name: Taboritsky's Revolutions+
mods.author: Taboritsky
mods.summary: Adds coups, revolutions, focus trees, civil wars, and post-victory objectives—overthrow any government on any map and remake the country.
mods.description:
Overthrow any government, on any map. Build a movement, fight the regime, and remake the country under a new name, flag, and government.

Features:
• Manual & Automatic Coups: Spend political capital on 10 actions across 6 stages while the government fights back.
• Country-Specific Factions: Custom movements for Russia, USA, China, UK, Germany, and more, plus era-appropriate movements for every other country.
• Unique Coups with Focus Trees: Includes Wagner Group, Holy Russian Empire, Operation Valkyrie, Union of Britain, and Illyrian Revival.
• Battle for the Capital: The final move of a coup plays out live on the map.
• Civil War & Collapse: The government fights its rivals, or the state splits apart while neighbors seize territory.
• Fund Coups Abroad: Back movements in other countries to spread your ideology.
• Post-Victory Objectives: Ranges from regional goals up to Very Hard world domination.
• Extras & Tools: Custom faction editor, popularity map, government history, and an in-game FAQ.

⚠️ Note: Works even WITHOUT the in-game revolution option enabled.
